question: Computer ka janak kise kaha jata hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: B — Charles Babbage ko computer ka janak kaha jata hai — unhone Analytical Engine banaya tha. | Galat kyun: A (Tim Berners-Lee) WWW ke janak hain; C (Bill Gates) Microsoft ke sansthapak hain; D (Alan Turing) computer vigyan ke janak mane jate hain, computer ke nahi. | Concept: 'Janak' ka joda — Babbage = computer, Berners-Lee = WWW. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Babbage = Analytical Engine = computer ka janak. | Source: notes/11_computer_knowledge.md §11.1.

question: CPU ko kya kaha jata hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: B — CPU (Central Processing Unit) ko computer ka brain kaha jata hai — isme ALU (ganana), CU (niyantran) aur Memory hote hain. | Galat kyun: A (soul) aur D (heart) koi manak naam nahi hain; C (memory) CPU ka hissa hai, poora CPU nahi. | Concept: CPU = ALU + CU + Memory — computer ka niyantran kendra. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: CPU = Brain; ALU = ganana, CU = niyantran. | Source: notes/11_computer_knowledge.md §11.1.

question: RAM ki visheshta kya hai?
option_b: Volatile — band hone par data mit jata hai
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: B — RAM volatile memory hai — computer band hone par iska data mit jata hai; yah kaam karte samay ki asthayi memory hai. | Galat kyun: A (non-volatile) ROM ki visheshta hai; C (permanent storage) hard disk/SSD ki visheshta hai; D (ROM jaisi) ulta hai — ROM non-volatile hoti hai. | Concept: Volatile = bijli band hote hi data gaya; non-volatile = data bana rehta hai. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: RAM = kaam ki mez (band hote hi saaf); ROM = kitab (bani rehti hai). | Source: notes/11_computer_knowledge.md §11.1.

question: 1 Byte me kitne bit hote hain?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: B — 1 Byte = 8 bit. | Galat kyun: A (4 bit) nibble hota hai; C (16 bit) 2 byte hote hain; D (1024) 1 KB me byte hote hain, bit nahi. | Concept: Bit < Byte < KB < MB < GB — har kadam 1024 guna (Byte ke baad). | Yaad rakhne ke liye: 8 bit = 1 Byte; 1024 Byte = 1 KB. | Source: notes/11_computer_knowledge.md §11.1.

question: MS Excel file ka extension kya hai?
